project_metadata.description: Evidence-backed domain model synthesized from the SRS.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages user registration, authentication, and personal profile information. This context is responsible for the identity and access management of all users on the platform.

capabilities.name: VerifyEmail
capabilities.description: Confirm the authenticity of a user's email address during registration.

capabilities.name: ViewProfile
capabilities.description: Users can view their name, gender, username, email, contact number, birthdate, profile picture

capabilities.name: RegisterToWebsite
capabilities.description: The non-registered users can register into the website by entering first name, middle name, last name, gender, profile picture, contact number, birthdate, username, email, password and then verify email. If verification is successful then the page is redirected to the login page.

capabilities.name: LoginToWebsite
capabilities.description: Registered users can log in to the system using their credentials. If username or email and password match then, users are logged in to the platform otherwise, error message for invalid username and password is displayed.

capabilities.name: RegisterUser
capabilities.description: Allow non-registered users to create an account by providing personal and login details, followed by email verification.

capabilities.name: LoginUser
capabilities.description: Enable registered users to gain access to the system using their credentials.

entities.name: User
entities.description: An individual interacting with the system, either registered or non-registered, possessing attributes like name, gender, username, email, contact number, birthdate, and profile picture.

entities.name: Profile
entities.description: A collection of personal information associated with a user account, including name, gender, username, email, contact number, birthdate, and profile picture.

value_objects.name: PasswordHash
value_objects.description: The hashed password for user authentication, subject to specific complexity rules.

value_objects.name: FullName
value_objects.description: The user's full name, including first, middle, and last names.

value_objects.name: Username
value_objects.description: A unique identifier chosen by a user for logging into the system.

value_objects.name: EmailAddress
value_objects.description: The email address used for user registration and login.

domain_events.name: UserEmailVerified
domain_events.description: A user's email address has been successfully verified.

domain_events.name: UserRegistered
domain_events.description: A new user has successfully registered on the platform.

domain_events.name: UserLoggedIn
domain_events.description: A registered user has successfully logged into the platform.

The 'birthdate' field is required for the 'User' entity.

bounded_contexts.description: Facilitates the process of users adding products for sale, managing offers, requests, and providing a dashboard for tracking these activities.

actors.name: Seller
actors.description: A consumer who sells products on the C2C e-commerce platform, responsible for listing goods.

capabilities.name: AddProduct
capabilities.description: Users can add product and its details with their information. They must specify product name, product category, picture of the product, owner name, and description of product, price details, product condition, warranty and home delivery details.

capabilities.name: ViewProductDashboard
capabilities.description: Users can view the number of products they have added to sell, requested to buy and been offered for the product they put on sale

capabilities.name: SellProduct
capabilities.description: Allow registered users to sell their product by adding it to their profile for public posting.

capabilities.name: BuyProduct
capabilities.description: Allow registered users to buy a product.

entities.name: Dashboard
entities.description: A personalized view containing product details and other user-specific information.

value_objects.name: ProductHomeDelivery
value_objects.description: Home delivery details for the product

aggregates.name: Offer
aggregates.description: This table stores the data of the buyer and seller name/username/email who offers the product to the customers and also the information of the offers that you have received from the user or probable buyer.

aggregates.name: Request
aggregates.description: This table stores the information of the requests made by the registered user and the requests made to the user by the probable buyer who are also the registered user on the site and the requests are stored on the profile page of the user.

domain_events.name: ProductAdded
domain_events.description: A product and its details have been added by a user.

domain_events.name: OfferReceived
domain_events.description: An offer has been received for a product.

domain_events.name: RequestMade
domain_events.description: A request has been made for a product.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the listing, searching, and detailed viewing of products available on the platform for both registered and non-registered users.

capabilities.name: SearchForProducts
capabilities.description: A search bar available in the platform can be used to search for the required product. Users can also search through the category of products. Users can input key words in the search bar and if the relevant match is found, then the title matching the word is displayed otherwise, ‘No products found’ message is displayed.

capabilities.name: ViewProductDetails
capabilities.description: The information like general details, seller details, product description, pricing details, delivery and warranty details can be seen.

capabilities.name: SearchForProducts
capabilities.description: A search bar available in the platform can be used to search for the required product if available in the database. Both registered and non-registered users can search through the category of products.

capabilities.name: ViewProductDetail
capabilities.description: The information like general details, seller details, product description, pricing details, delivery and warranty details can be seen like non-registered users.

capabilities.name: SearchProduct
capabilities.description: Enable users to find products using keywords or by browsing categories.

capabilities.name: ViewProducts
capabilities.description: Allow registered users to view products.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: An item offered for sale on the platform, with associated details like name, category, picture, description, price, condition, warranty, and delivery information.

entities.name: ProductDetail
entities.description: Comprehensive information about a product, encompassing general, seller, pricing, delivery, and warranty aspects.

value_objects.name: ProductCategory
value_objects.description: The classification under which a product is categorized.

value_objects.name: ProductDescription
value_objects.description: A summary or detailed text describing the product.

value_objects.name: ProductPrice
value_objects.description: The monetary value of the product.

value_objects.name: WarrantyDetail
value_objects.description: Information regarding the warranty period and conditions for the product.

bounded_contexts.description: Provides resources for users to get help, view documentation, and contact platform developers.

actors.name: Developer
actors.description: An individual associated with the platform who can be contacted by users via social media.

capabilities.name: ContactDeveloper
capabilities.description: Users can contact any developer by clicking the different social media links associated with the developer for which the information like name, email and message is required.

capabilities.name: ViewUserManual
capabilities.description: Allow users to access and read the website's instructional guide.

capabilities.name: ViewWebsiteUserManual
capabilities.description: User can visit help page to view the website user manual. The user manual contains the instructions on how to register to the platform, deal with forgotten password, search for products, contact the seller and so on.

capabilities.name: ViewUserManual

entities.name: HelpPage

assumptions: The information stored are secured and verified.
The performance of the platform is good.
The success of the system depends on:
The system is built with the perspective of HCI.
We have assumed that all the users using this platform are capable of connecting their devices to the Internet and navigate the browser on their devices to the address of Kinmail website.

We have assumed that the Kinmail will be running on a properly working web server and database system with an Internet connection that allows the system to perform all communications between the users.
